name: list-payments
description: Lists recent Stripe payments (charges), newest first, with amount, currency, status and refund state, optionally for one customer id from stripe__find-customer. Amounts are in the smallest currency unit. Each charge id, or its payment_intent, feeds stripe__refund-payment. When hasMore is true, nextCursor passed back as cursor reads the next page.

limit.description: Maximum number of charges to return, from 1 to 100. Defaults to 10.

customer.description: Optional Stripe customer ID, such as one returned by stripe__find-customer.

cursor.description: The nextCursor of an earlier answer with the same filters, to read the payments after it.
